question: What divine identities and attributes warrant victorious praise of Mādhava?
premises: Mādhava is hailed as the self of illusion.
Mādhava is hailed as the bearer of the conch.
inference: Mādhava deserves victorious praise as the eternal, illusion-embodying conch-bearer.
plain_english: Victory to you, O Mādhava, whose self is illusion; victory to you, O eternal bearer of the conch.
